node.title: Re: Sort the hash array
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You're not storing $timereceived as part of the array. If you did store it like this:

push @$records, { timereceived => $dtevent, ...

then after the loop you could do this:

@$records = sort { $a->{timereceived} <=> $b->{timereceived} } @$records;

because [mod://DateTime] objects overload the numeric comparison operators. BTW, there does not appear to be a need for the array reference $records in your code, you could just use a plain array my @records.

Update: See also [doc://sort] and [doc://perlfaq4#How-do-I-sort-an-array-by-(anything)?]
